quizName:
Hardest Questions in Louisiana
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: What should you do if you encounter an aggressive driver?

options.text: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
Cut them off to slow them down.
Make gestures to show you disapprove.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
questions.explanation: Stay calm and create distance between you and the other driver. Slow down and let them pass. Do not look at them or make rude gestures.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that traffic may come from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What should you do if you are in a serious car crash?
questions.explanation: Stop your vehicle and move it off the road if possible. Call 911 if anyone is hurt and help them. Report the crash to police if there is an injury, death, or more than $1,000 in property damage.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Do not park on the right side.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash over a symbol means that action is not allowed. In this case, right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot drive in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not permitted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You may pass a slow vehicle if you are quick.
You may pass if you know the road.
You may pass only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white with black markings. Drivers must follow all rules on these signs. Where this sign is posted, passing is not allowed.

questions.question: How can alcohol affect you while driving?
questions.explanation: Alcohol affects the brain areas that control judgment and self-control. It slows your reaction time, coordination, and balance. It also impairs your vision and ability to judge distance.

questions.question: What should you do before driving a friend's unfamiliar car?

options.text: Do not worry because all cars are the same.
Do not tell your friend you are unfamiliar with it.
Ignore any problems to avoid embarrassing your friend.
Take a few minutes to learn where all controls and equipment are located.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to learn where all controls and equipment are located.
questions.explanation: Before driving an unfamiliar car, spend a few minutes learning where the turn signals, headlights, wipers, brakes, gear selector, and horn are located. Fix any problems before driving.

questions.question: You should slow down in which situations?

options.text: When the road is wet or slippery.

questions.explanation: Slow down on narrow or winding roads, at intersections, at railroad crossings, on hills, in sharp curves, where you see pedestrians or hazards, and when roads are wet or slippery.

questions.question: You are angry after something happens at work. When you get to your car, what should you do?

options.text: Play the radio loudly so you won't think about it.
Drive fast on the interstate to let off steam.
Take a few minutes to calm down before you drive.
Stop at a bar and have drinks before driving home.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down before you drive.
questions.explanation: If you are upset or angry, calm down before driving. Driving while emotional is dangerous for you and others on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
These lanes are for buses and shared vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: Anything that requires you to ____ could cause a crash.

options.text: Take your eyes off the road
Take your hands off the wheel
Take your attention away from driving

questions.explanation: A distraction is anything that takes your attention away from driving, your eyes off the road, or your hands off the wheel.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a traffic signal is coming. Be ready for a red light, yellow light, or cross traffic.

questions.question: Driving ability can be affected by:
questions.explanation: Safe driving requires good physical condition. Alcohol, drugs, and drowsiness all reduce your ability to drive safely.

questions.question: When driving on highways, you should:

options.text: Be ready to react to hazards.

questions.explanation: Stay alert on highways and be ready for hazards. Keep your eyes moving to avoid highway hypnosis. Do not stare at one spot for more than a few seconds.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you traffic only moves in one direction on this street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is red.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is green.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is at the next intersection.

questions.question: When stopped for a traffic violation or equipment check, what must you show the officer?
questions.explanation: You must have three documents when driving: your license, proof of registration, and proof of insurance. You must show all three if stopped by an officer.

questions.question: What can cause distracted driving?

options.text: Talking or texting on a cell phone.
Changing a radio station or CD.

questions.explanation: Drivers make about 200 decisions for every mile driven. Any task that takes your attention away from driving is dangerous. You must focus on driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means the action is not allowed. Right turns are forbidden where this sign is posted.

questions.question: You miss your exit on a freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Make a quick turn from your lane.
Drive to the next exit or turn where you can safely turn around.
Signal other drivers to stop so you can turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive to the next exit or turn where you can safely turn around.
questions.explanation: Never back up on a freeway or shoulder. Continue to the next exit or location where you can safely turn around.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers what they must and must not do. U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: When turning or changing lanes, you must:

options.text: Always signal, even if no other cars are nearby.
Signal only if other cars are visible.
Signal only in heavy night traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always signal, even if no other cars are nearby.
questions.explanation: Always signal when turning, changing lanes, or leaving the curb. Make this a habit, not just when you think someone is watching.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign forbids U-turns. Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Drivers turning left on green must let oncoming traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers turning left on green must let oncoming traffic go first.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic signal to show that left-turning drivers do not have the right-of-way. They must wait for oncoming traffic to clear before turning.

questions.question: An aggressive driver is tailgating you. What should you do?

options.text: Make eye contact with the driver.
Speed up while they are passing.

questions.explanation: Get out of an aggressive driver's way. Avoid eye contact. Speeding up may anger them more and increase danger.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossing road and intersection are ahead.

questions.question: When you see a school bus stopped with its stop arm extended, what should you do?

options.text: Stop completely and wait until the arm is pulled in.
Honk your horn and pass on the left side.
Keep driving once you think all children have left the bus.
Pass the bus before its door opens.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and wait until the arm is pulled in.
questions.explanation: You must come to a complete stop when a school bus has its stop arm extended. Do not drive until the stop arm is pulled back in.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.
There is a bump in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Yellow diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about hazards. This sign warns you that wet pavement can be slippery and make it harder to control your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop at an intersection and yield the right-of-way. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign tells you that a stop sign is coming up so you can prepare to stop.

questions.question: What does alcohol do to a driver?
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol hurts your vision, judgment, concentration, and coordination.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must and must not do. This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane must turn left.

questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must and must not do. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn you about railroad crossings. This sign tells you that a railroad crossing is coming up and you should watch for trains.

questions.question: What should you do when you see railroad tracks ahead?

options.text: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
Speed up to cross the tracks before the gate comes down.
Do not worry about how many tracks you have to cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: When approaching railroad tracks, look and listen for trains, slow down, and be prepared to stop if needed.

questions.question: What should you do before you turn?
questions.explanation: Before turning, turn on your signal three to four seconds early so other drivers know what you plan to do.
